import sys; sys.path.insert(0,str(WORK))
code = r'''
import numpy as np, json
from lib7 import *
def carry_gain(X, cold):
    Xc=X-X.mean(1,keepdims=True); pc=cold-cold.mean(1,keepdims=True)
    a=(Xc*pc).sum()/(pc**2).sum(); k=(Xc*pc).sum(1)/(pc**2).sum(1)/a
    return a*k
def prep_anchors(Z, tr, na=1008):
    Zt=Z[tr]; Wf=anchor_dirs(Zt); Kc=gelu(Zt@Wf.T); Kc=.5*(Kc+Kc.T)
    piv=pivchol(Kc,na); return Wf[piv], Kc[np.ix_(piv,piv)], piv
def deploy_sim(M,C,M0,y,tr,te,cold,gM,gC,c=10,cr=1.0,lam=.05,c0=.5,refit=False):
    Y=np.eye(8)[y]; Lin=lin_feats(M0,tr); mu=M[tr].mean(0)
    Z=pool_z(M,C,c,mu,cr); Wd,Kaa,piv=prep_anchors(Z,tr)
    Phi=feats(Z,Wd); coef,b=fit(Phi[tr],Lin[tr],Y[tr],Kaa,lam,c0)
    Sl=Lin@coef[1008:]
    lamb=np.sqrt((cold[tr]**2).sum()/(Sl[tr]**2).sum()); cnew=lamb*Sl
    Mn=M.copy(); Cn=C.copy(); Mn[:,RES]+=gM[:,None]*(cnew-cold); Cn[:,RES]+=gC[:,None]*(cnew-cold)
    mun=Mn[tr].mean(0); Zn=pool_z(Mn,Cn,c,mun,cr); Phin=feats(Zn,Wd)
    L8=Zn[:,RES]-Zn[:,RES].mean(1,keepdims=True); Slc=Sl-Sl.mean(1,keepdims=True)
    beta=(L8[tr]*Slc[tr]).sum()/(L8[tr]**2).sum()
    Sjoint=np.c_[Phi,Lin]@coef+b
    Sdep=Phin@coef[:1008]+beta*L8+b
    out=dict(joint=(Sjoint[te].argmax(1)==y[te]).mean(), dep=(Sdep[te].argmax(1)==y[te]).mean())
    if refit:
        c2,b2=fit(Phin[tr],np.zeros((len(y),0)),Y[tr]-beta*L8[tr],Kaa,lam,c0)
        S2=Phin@c2+beta*L8+b2; out['dep_refit']=(S2[te].argmax(1)==y[te]).mean()
    return out, dict(coef=coef,b=b,Wd=Wd,piv=piv,lamb=lamb,beta=beta,mu=mu,mun=mun,Mn=Mn,Cn=Cn,Sdep=Sdep,Sjoint=Sjoint,Zn=Zn)
'''
